boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented University of Tampa study settings, from library rooms to outdoor campus spaces.

cards.title: Macdonald-Kelce Library
cards.subtitle: Two floors of study space
cards.notes: Start here when you want a library setting with research materials nearby. The university documents two stories of study spaces in this building.
cards.short_summary: A two-story library study setting with research support nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Macdonald-Kelce Library offers two stories of study spaces, and research librarians are available to help students locate class and research materials.
cards.access_notes: University page identifies the library as a campus study location; confirm building access and current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Large Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Macdonald-Kelce Library, first and second floors
cards.notes: Use a large room for project work. Two second-floor rooms have monitors and can be reserved; first-floor large rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.short_summary: Large library rooms with a choice of reservable or walk-in options.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has four large study rooms: two second-floor rooms with monitors that can be reserved, plus two first-floor rooms available first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Macdonald-Kelce Library at The University of Tampa
cards.access_notes: Second-floor large rooms require a key from the Circulation Desk and may be reserved; first-floor large rooms are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Small Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Macdonald-Kelce Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring one study partner or work solo in a smaller room. All six are on the second floor and operate on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.short_summary: Six small, second-floor rooms intended for one or two students.
cards.evidence_claim: Macdonald-Kelce Library has six small second-floor study rooms suitable for one or two students, available first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Macdonald-Kelce Library at The University of Tampa
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; these rooms are described by the university as suitable for one or two students.

cards.title: AV2 Classroom
cards.subtitle: Macdonald-Kelce Library
cards.notes: Check whether AV2 is open before settling in. The library makes this large classroom available to students when it is not scheduled for other functions.
cards.short_summary: A library classroom that may be available between scheduled uses.
cards.evidence_claim: Macdonald-Kelce Library's large classroom, AV2, is available for student use when it is not being used for other functions.
cards.source_title: Macdonald-Kelce Library at The University of Tampa
cards.access_notes: Available only when not in use for other functions; verify availability with the library.

cards.entity_name: Daly Innovation and Collaboration Building Study Rooms
cards.title: Daly ICB Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Floor one, Daly Innovation and Collaboration Building
cards.notes: Meet a study group in the Daly ICB's first-floor study rooms. Pair the session with the building's adjacent lounges or outdoor patio if available.
cards.short_summary: First-floor study rooms in the Innovation and Collaboration Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor of the Maureen A. Daly Innovation and Collaboration Building includes lounges, study rooms and an outdoor patio.
cards.access_notes: The university lists these study rooms on floor one; check current building access and room-use requirements on arrival.

cards.entity_name: Daly Innovation and Collaboration Building Lounges
cards.title: Daly ICB Lounges
cards.subtitle: Floors one and two, Daly Innovation and Collaboration Building
cards.notes: Choose a lounge when you need an open seating area rather than a closed room. The building lists lounges on both its first and second floors.
cards.short_summary: Open lounge settings on the first and second floors of Daly ICB.
cards.evidence_claim: The Daly Innovation and Collaboration Building lists lounges on floor one and lounges and meeting rooms on floor two.
cards.access_notes: Located in an academic building; confirm current access and whether a particular lounge is available for study.

cards.entity_name: Stephen H. Mauldin Academic Study Lounge
cards.title: Stephen H. Mauldin Academic Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Martinez Athletics Center
cards.notes: Use this two-story lounge for either individual work or a group session. It is named for alumnus Stephen H. Mauldin and is available to UT students.
cards.short_summary: A two-story academic lounge for individual and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stephen H. Mauldin Academic Study Lounge in the Martinez Athletics Center is a two-story space available to all UT students for individual and group study.
cards.source_title: Academic Study Lounge is Named for Steve Mauldin ’90
cards.access_notes: The university states the lounge is available to all UT students; verify Martinez Athletics Center access before visiting.

cards.title: Plant Park
cards.subtitle: Riverfront campus park
cards.notes: Take your reading outdoors along the Hillsborough River. The university identifies this park as an outdoor study space and notes its waterfront walkway connection.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront outdoor study setting with a campus-to-Riverwalk connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Plant Park offers outdoor study spaces, and its extended waterfront walkway connects campus to downtown and the Tampa Riverwalk.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; plan around weather and follow posted park or campus guidelines.

cards.title: Vaughn Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Outside the Vaughn Center
cards.notes: Set up outside the Vaughn Center when you want a courtyard setting. UT's self-guided tour specifically identifies the courtyard as a place students study in free time.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor courtyard beside the campus student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Tampa's self-guided tour identifies Vaughn Courtyard, outside the Vaughn Center, as a place where students socialize and study in their free time.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space outside Vaughn Center; use subject to weather and any posted campus-event restrictions.

cards.entity_name: Ferman Center for the Arts Study Spaces
cards.title: Ferman Center for the Arts Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Ferman Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Work near the arts programs in the Ferman Center. The university documents study spaces alongside collaborative practice studios and faculty-office access.
cards.short_summary: Study spaces within the university's fine and performing arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ferman Center for the Arts offers study spaces, collaborative practice studios and access to faculty offices.
cards.access_notes: Located within an academic arts building; confirm current building access and any room-specific limitations before use.
